## Summary

What this change does and which Initiative/Wave/Work it corresponds to.

## Golden path

- [ ] The change was produced through `spec → spec-review → plan →
      plan-review → build → build-review → ship`.
- [ ] Initiative/Wave/Work ids are referenced in the description.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (typecheck, lint, build, tests, smoke,
      cli-check).
- [ ] Behavior is preserved unless a Work's acceptance criteria require
      otherwise.

## Review notes

Anything the reviewer should focus on, including which acceptance criteria
were covered and which competing proposals were reviewed.
